test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT correct about agriculture industry?

options.text: Green revolution enabled India to achieve self-sufficiency in food grain production.
Green revolution started the usage of HYV seeds.
Green revolution resulted in the improvement in oilseeds.
Green revolution led to the introduction of new technology.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Green revolution resulted in the improvement in oilseeds. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Green Revolution primarily **focused on increasing the **production of staple crops l**ike wheat and rice through the use of high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds, chemical fertilizers, and modern irrigation techniques.
 
• While it did contribute to the improvement of several crops, **oilseeds were not the primary focus during the Green Revolution.**
 
• The improvement of oilseeds, like **mustard**, **groundnut**, and **soybean**, gained more attention later, during the **Yellow Revolution** (1980s).
 
• The Yellow Revolution, led by government initiatives and research programs, specifically focused on enhancing the production of oilseeds in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Green Revolution was a period of **agricultural transformation** in India that used modern technology to increase food production. 
 
• The Green Revolution i**ntroduced HYV seeds, **which were more productive and had a shorter maturity period. This allowed for multiple cropping cycles per year. 
 
• The Green Revolution al**so introduced other technologies, such as irrigation facilities, tractors, pesticides, and fertilizers. **
 
• **The Green Revolution helped India become self-sufficient in food grain production. **
